title: epipactis viridiflora var. pollinensis
intro: Epipactis viridiflora var. pollinensis, commonly known as the green helleborine, is a variety of orchid native to Europe and parts of Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis viridiflora var. pollinensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and fever, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
